recreation_brief: 1. Create a new PowerPoint slide with a light gray background (#f0f0f0). 2. Draw a thin dark red (#8b0000) rectangular border around the slide content area, leaving a small margin. 3. Add a solid black (#000000) horizontal bar across the entire bottom edge. 4. Insert a text box at top-center with the text 'Update Weights of Output Layer' in bold red (#c00000) sans-serif font, split into two lines: 'Update Weights of' on line 1 and 'Output Layer' on line 2. 5. Insert a second text box centered below the title with the text '( Weights from previous layer to output layer )' in blue (#0000ff) sans-serif font; apply underline formatting to the word 'previous' and the phrase 'output layer'. 6. In the top-right corner, draw a small circle containing the number '6' in black text. 7. Ensure all text is centered horizontally on the slide.
